Riley (People Ops): Final reminder: review window closes Friday EOD UTC. Please confirm backups and upload any late evidence by Thursday noon UTC.
Jo (ENG Manager): Quick Q  if backup reviewer is in a different org level, do we note that?
Riley (People Ops): Yes  add a comment: 'Backup reviewer: Name (title)  reason: timezone/PTO'. That helps calibration reviewers understand context.
Omar (Product): We have one borderline case on my team; can backups see the manager notes?
Riley (People Ops): Backups should be given review access. If permissions missing, DM me and I'll grant temporary view access.
Zoe (Recruiting): I'm holding candidate interviews in the afternoons Thursday/Friday. If you need me to move any, DM with names and times and I'll shuffle.
Jo (ENG Manager): Added backups for Team Mercury: Priya (backup, staff PM) and Carlos (backup, senior eng). Priya may not have done reviewer training.
Riley (People Ops): If Priya hasn't done training, note that in the review and we'll include a 15-min calibration check-in before finalizing.
people-ops-bot: Reminder: "Upload late evidence / confirm backups" scheduled in 14 hours. :bell:
Jo (ENG Manager): Done  backups set and evidence uploaded. Thanks.
Riley (People Ops): Thanks everyone. If anything changes after EOD Thurs, DM and cc people-ops@redwood.com and we'll triage.
